## API Details

**API Name:**  
<!-- e.g. India Holidays API -->

**Category:**  
<!-- e.g. Government, Finance, Transport, etc. -->

**Description (keep it short, under 80 chars):**  
<!-- e.g. Get list of Indian public holidays by year -->

**Documentation Link:**  
<!-- e.g. https://api.example.com/docs -->

**Authentication Type:**  
- [ ] None (completely free, no signup)
- [ ] API Key (free signup required)
- [ ] OAuth

**Is the API free to use?**  
- [ ] Yes, completely free
- [ ] Free tier available
- [ ] Paid only

## Checklist

- [ ] I have tested the API link and it works
- [ ] This API is India-specific or India-focused
- [ ] This API is not already in the list
- [ ] The API is legal and publicly accessible
